name: ucp-onboard
description: Agent skills for auditing merchants and preparing UCP (2026-04-08, incl. cart) and OpenAI ACP commerce integrations.

interface.shortDescription: Audit merchants and prepare agentic commerce feeds and profiles.
interface.longDescription: A commerce onboarding plugin for AI agents. It audits merchant sites, maps product catalogs, generates UCP profiles (UCP 2026-04-08, including the cart capability), generates a sandbox checkout server, exports OpenAI Agentic Commerce Protocol feeds, and validates deployed integrations.
defaultPrompt: Audit this merchant for agentic commerce readiness.
Convert this catalog to an OpenAI ACP product feed.
Generate a UCP profile for this store.
